Rig 05 + vertical running wheel

Ø200 x 50 wheel with rubber tread, straight headbar on 2 posts. Everything else as Rig 05. Sizes in mm.
Moving around
• Rotate: left-drag (trackpad: click-drag with one finger)
• Pan: right-drag or two-finger drag / Shift+drag
• Zoom: scroll / pinch
• Views: 0 iso 1 front 2 top 3 right 4 back 6 left, F fit

Inspecting a part
• Click a part (3D or list) → details on the right
• Show only this part (I) isolates it with its size box; Show all (A) returns

Measuring
• M → click two points → distance + ΔX ΔY ΔZ (mm)
• "Snap to corner" locks to the nearest mesh vertex for exact edge-to-edge values
• Coordinates: origin = plate centre, Z 0 = plate top, +X front (mouse faces), +Y mouse-left

Click any part to inspect. Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · press M to measure.

Selected part

Nothing selected.

Measurement

Press Measure, then click two points.

Baseplate holes

Rig 05 plate holes (for the ball layout) are kept in this model.
